title: TreeTip Placer: Conservative fixed-tree phylogenetic placement and clade screening for Clostridioides MLST sequences
description: TreeTip Placer (v1.0.0) performs quality-controlled coordinate projection, nearest-reference panel arbitration, constrained weighted least-squares fixed-tree placement, and conservative phylogenetic clade assignment for concatenated seven-locus Clostridioides difficile and cryptic Clostridioides MLST alignments.

creators.name: Rodríguez, César
